overrides.text: From Joshua Fromm (ts=1780421903.673979): ok all the payload parts for modifying both the murphys pond payloads and the gimbal are in the process of ordering right now, most parts to arrive ~ end of the week. biggest task is going to be rewiring the new db9 to mate up to the new style, which isn't a big deal at all. should be able to modify all 3 payloads in one day or less
